document_metadata.title: 9、INT. TED'S OFFICE - NEWSROOM - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Ted, pressured by a triple-dog-dare, publicly asks Christy to prom, causing mass laughter; she rejects him harshly, calling him pathetic, while Julie helps him up, calling it an emergency.

entities.name: Julie confronts Ted about working on the school paper
entities.description: Julie sits across from Ted, acknowledging the punitive nature of her assignment to the school paper and expressing her disdain for the role, while sizing up the situation.

entities.name: Julie rests her feet on Ted's files and blows a bubble
entities.description: In a defiant and casual gesture, Julie leans back in the chair, places her feet on Ted's desk files, and blows a large bubble, signaling her attitude toward the meeting.

entities.name: Ted defends his investigative reporting on trash collection
entities.description: Ted recounts how his award-winning exposé on overflowing school dumpsters led to the city adding an extra weekday trash pickup, emphasizing the impact of his journalism.

entities.name: Julie sarcastically questions the significance of Ted's reporting
entities.description: Julie mocks Ted's journalistic achievements by suggesting his work caused a surge in chocolate sprinkle sales, highlighting her skepticism and disdain.

entities.name: Ted expresses conflicted feelings about Julie's punishment
entities.description: Ted admits he loved the underground magazine 'Exposed!' and regrets that Julie was caught, while trying to convince her the school paper isn't so bad.

entities.name: Julie notices Ted looking at Christy in the newsroom
entities.description: Julie observes Ted glancing at Christy as she moves through the newsroom, interpreting his gaze as romantic interest and calling attention to it.

entities.name: Julie mocks Ted's admiration for Christy's journalism
entities.description: When Ted praises Christy's talent and predicts a Pulitzer, Julie responds with a crude joke implying Christy's success is due to sexual favors, not skill.

entities.name: Julie dares Ted to ask Christy to the prom
entities.description: Julie interrupts Ted's denials of romantic interest and issues a 'triple-dog-dare' for him to ask Christy to the prom, pushing him to act on his apparent attraction.
